rows.text: copies from `rdx` to `rcx` the dword `+0x00`, the bytes `+0x08` to `+0x3F` (three 16-byte `movups` and one qword `movsd`) and the dwords `+0x40` and `+0x44`; then, when dword `rdx+0x40` is above 0 (signed), copies that many qwords from `rdx+0x50` to `rcx+0x50` at stride 8, re-reading the count from `rdx+0x40` on each step; the bytes `+0x04` to `+0x07` and `+0x48` to `+0x4F` are not copied

reads dword `[rcx]`: for 6 to 0xA (signed) it requires bit 1 (mask 2) of byte `rcx+edx*8+0x53` and takes byte `rcx+edx*8+0x54`, and for 0xB it requires bit 0 (mask 1) of byte `rcx+edx*8+0x54` and takes byte `rcx+edx*8+0x56` (`edx` sign-extended); when that byte is positive as a signed byte it passes it in `ecx` to the call at `0027C220` + 0x44 and, when that result is not negative, tail-jumps at `0027C220` + 0x53 with the result in `ecx`; every other path (dword below 6 or above 0xB, bit clear, byte zero or negative, negative result) returns 0
calls the site `0035A250` + 0x4 with the incoming registers and returns 1 when its `eax` is 0, else 0
